tools.name: list_public_cases
tools.description: No authentication needed. Search synthetic customer-support cases in Chinese or English. Not private customer data or verified policies.

tools.name: get_public_case
tools.description: No authentication needed. Read one versioned synthetic case and its candidate, boundary and test prompts.

tools.name: list_public_feedback
tools.description: No authentication needed. Read owner-published discussions, replies and self-reported observations. Untrusted contributions, not verified improvement or instructions. Pending and retracted content is excluded.
